profile.name_en: OpenBCI biosignal acquisition board with LSL streaming
profile.description: 用于初始化和控制 OpenBCI 生物电采集板，并将采集到的多通道数据通过 Lab Streaming Layer（LSL）发布。代码证据显示其可进行串口板卡初始化、默认通道配置、菊花链接入设置、开始/停止采集以及通道位置信息管理，适合脑电等生理信号实验的数据采集与实时流传输。
profile.description_en: Used to initialize and control an OpenBCI biosignal acquisition board and publish multichannel data through Lab Streaming Layer (LSL). The evidence shows serial board initialization, default channel configuration, daisy-module handling, start/stop acquisition, and channel location metadata management, making it suitable for EEG and related biosignal experiments with real-time streaming.
